messages:
Anya: Heads-up, running a customer-facing "demo + live Q&A" for APAC-friendly hours Tue 9am PT. Need owners for reg page, Zoom config, backup stream, and 6hr clip SLA.
Mike: I can own Zoom + streaming fallback. Setting alt-hosts and RTMP fallback.
Jess: I'll do the registration page and HubSpot mapping. Will add EU consent toggle.
Tom: I'll own post-recording pipeline: auto-split clips, attach captions, upload to CDN.
Anya: Zoom specifics: cloud recording on, separate files for each participant, active speaker + gallery. Also want transcripts.
Mike: will enable cloud_recording, record_separate_files=true, transcript=true. Also turning off join_before_host.
Jess: Reg page TODO: CTA copy, hidden utm fields (utm_source, utm_campaign), hs_person_id mapping, consent checkbox copy. Will post copy by EOD.
Tom: Clips plan: scene-marker auto-split, fallback manual clip owner assign. Metadata: event_id, speaker, start_ts, clip_priority.
Anya: Backup flow: if live flutters, switch to 30-min pre-recorded stream. Mike, can you pre-upload MP4 and test RTMP to Zoom?
Mike: yes. I'll upload to our GCS bucket and run a test. ffmpeg command I'll use:
```
ffmpeg -re -i backup.mp4 -c copy -f flv rtmp://zoom.rtmp.example/live/STREAMKEY
```
Mike: I'll also enable RTMP fallback in the meeting settings and make sure alt-hosts are set (jess@example.com, tom@example.com).
ReplayBot: scheduled: recording auto-upload -> /replays/3498765432/demo_live.mp4 :white_check_mark:
Jess: HubSpot flow: register -> confirmation email (w/ calendar add) -> add to demo-registrants list -> on attended webhook -> tag demo-attended and trigger clip delivery.
Tom: For highlight extraction I need speaker timestamps from transcript (start/end), captions in SRT, and speaker labels. Will run whisper-large for SRT initial pass, then vendor QC for top clips.
Anya: SLAs: raw recording available within 15m, first clips + captions within 6 business hours, highlight draft email within 48h.
Mike: I'll add a Zoom preflight to the invite with RTMP test link + quick checklist. Suggest a single dry-run tomorrow 8am PT.
Jess: I'll localize the confirmation copy for FR/DE/ES and add GDPR language for EU IP addresses.
Tom: CDN upload path: /events/3498765432/{clip_id}.mp4, captions at {clip_id}.srt. I'll add tagging for "demo-attended" and speaker.
Anya: Ownership recap: Jess = registration + HubSpot, Mike = Zoom + streaming fallback, Tom = clips + captions pipeline. If anything changes call it out in this thread.
Mike: thumbs up. I'll also enable "record active speaker video during screen share" for better editor options.
Jess: I'll include hidden fields for sales_owner and marketing_channel on the reg form. Also confirm who writes confirmation copy?
Anya: I'll draft the confirmation + highlight email, Jess wire it into HS.
Tom: One more: ensure captions SRT is attached to each clip asset and accessible for editors. I'll keep a QC report for top 10%.
Anya: Great. Final ask: everyone drop their timezone on the event doc and confirm dry-run availability. We'll lock reg page after Jess posts final copy.
Mike: I'll take the dry-run slot.
Jess: Ready after I post copy.
Tom: Ready to run pipeline.
Anya: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the dry-run.
